name: Globant S.A.

overview_text: Globant is a digitally native company that helps organizations thrive in a digital and AI-powered future through industry-focused solutions. It specializes in digital and cognitive transformation via AI-powered engineering, experience design, and technology modernization. Publicly traded on NYSE (GLOB) with a decentralized global delivery model across 27+ countries and 60+ offices, serving Fortune 500 clients with AI Studios and subscription-based AI Pods.
